import datetime

def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    if months_ahead is None:
        raise TypeError("months_ahead must be an int")
    month = start.month - 1 + months_ahead
    year = start.year + month // 12
    month = month % 12 + 1
    return datetime.date(year, month, start.day)
